HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   C. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

12. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

16. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
